reading.body:
Dell operates a facility at 350 Holger Way in North San Jose, but publishes no power capacity, floor space, or technical specifications for this location. The company confirms ownership as of September 2026, yet the site remains opaque to public disclosure. Without published figures, this campus cannot be ranked among California's disclosed data center capacity.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities of which only 11 publish power specifications totaling 365 MW. This facility does not appear in that published set. Dell's 350 Holger Way thus contributes an unknown amount to both the state's total and Dell's own disclosed footprint.

For a reader assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the absence of published specifications means it cannot yet be counted. The facility exists and Dell owns it, but the binding constraint on evaluating its role in AI compute is the lack of any public statement of its power delivery, electrical infrastructure, or intended use. Until Dell publishes capacity figures, this location remains invisible to grid-constrained AI planning.
